questions.question: Feeding Birds
answers: Jim's friend David Smith kept birds. One day David phoned and told Jim that he would be away for a week. He asked Jim to feed the birds for him and said he would leave his key in Jim's mailbox. Unfortunately, Jim didn't remember to feed the birds until the night before David was going to return. Jim rushed out of his house and it was already dark when he arrived at David's. He soon found the key David gave him could unlock neither the front door nor the back door! Jim kept thinking of what David would say when he came back. Then Jim noticed that one bedroom window was open. He found a big stone and pushed it under the window. Because the stone was very heavy, he made a lot of noise. But in the end, he managed to climb up. Jim had one leg inside the bedroom when he suddenly realized that someone was shining a torch up at him. He looked down and saw a policeman and an old lady, one of David's neighbours. "What are you doing up there?" said the policeman. Feeling like a fool, Jim replied, "I was going to feed Mr. Smith's birds."
